Judge for yourself
Nov 2025 • Couples
We visited here a few times while in the area. The pizzas are nice but on the 2nd visit it got weird. I ordered mozzarella/ham pizza. When it arrived on the table from the wood fired oven, the topping was cold. Apparently it’s common to serve pizza with cold toppings, I was told! This made the pizza base soggy and inedible. It went back to be exchanged for a pasta dish, that came out on the smallest bowl they could find in the kitchen! The pasta was under cooked, not seasoned and the bolognese was very salty. When I asked to pay the bill, I was ignored. It seems that if you don’t like the food here or comment, you are made to feel uncomfortable so we left after paying an expensive bill for food that didn’t deliver. The manager tried to tell me they make the best food, as we left but unfortunately I will leave it to the community of TP. If you’re in the area give it a go. You might enjoy your food. Domino’s doesn’t do cold pizza toppings. Disappointed on this occasion.
Read more
Written November 18, 2025
Lance L
Celica, I am very sorry to read this story and for sure the Pizza should be hot. Please understand though that our method of preparation is authentic Italian so its not Dominos in Derby, however, even in Italy the pizzas are served hot so my apologies for that.
As for the pasta, it is always cooked 'al dente' very important part of Italian popular culture. In France and UK we tend to cook it to the time indicated on the pack which, by Italian standards is too much. In SE Asia the noodles are cooked to death, a ig challenge when training local crew.
The Manager was correct, we do make the best Italian food in Hoi An/Da Nang but it seems in your case we 'dropped the ball' and for that I am truly sorry.
Your next meal is on me if you are inn the area and my profound apologies once more. This was not, for you, a typical day at La Riva-Lance. ( also disappointed)
